data.name: Anjam
data.gender_notes: Anjam is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Ajm', which means 'to vanquish'. In Islamic history, Anjam refers to the name of Prophet Ibrahim's (AS) son, born as a result of his prayer for a child. This name signifies the triumph of faith and trust in Allah. The name Anjam carries the meaning “Victory” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Anjam usually hope their child will grow to embody victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine victory, instilling courage and faith in the heart.
data.etymology: Anjam belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anjam total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: انجام
in_arabic.meaning: النهاية أو الخاتمة أو نتيجة الشيء
in_arabic.long_meaning: انجام مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'ن-ج-م' والذي يعني النهاية أو الخاتمة. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى نتيجة أو نهاية شيء ما. في بعض الأحيان، يُستخدم أيضًا للإشارة إلى الهدف أو الغاية النهائية. وفي القرآن الكريم، نجد أن هناك آيات تشير إلى نهاية الأشياء وختامها، مما يعطي هذا الاسم عمقًا دينيًا وروحانيًا.

in_urdu.name: انجام
in_urdu.long_meaning: انجام عربی زبان کے جڑ 'ن-ج-م' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خاتمہ یا نتیجہ۔ اردو میں، یہ نام کسی چیز کے آخر یا نتیجے کو ظاہر کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، یہ نام مقصد یا غاية کو بھی ظاہر کر سکتا ہے۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعے استعمال کیا جاتا رہا ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں۔

in_hindi.name: अंजाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अंजाम नाम अरबी भाषा के मूल 'न-ज-म' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है समाप्ति या परिणाम। हिंदी में, यह नाम किसी चीज़ के अंतिम परिणाम या समाप्ति को दर्शाने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम महत्वपूर्ण है और अक्सर बच्चों के नामकरण में प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व भी रखता है।

in_pashto.long_meaning: انجام د عربي ژبې د ريښې 'ن-ج-م' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د پایلو یا نتیجې څخه عبارت دی. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د یو شی پایلو یا نتیجې ته اشاره کوي. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، دا نوم د يو هدف يا موخې ته د رسېدو لپاره کارول کېږي. دا نوم تاريخي او مذهبي ارزښت لري.

in_english.name: Anjam
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anjam is derived from the Arabic root 'n-j-m', which means end, conclusion, or result. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies the outcome or culmination of something. It is also associated with the concept of purpose or goal. Historically, this name has been used across various Muslim cultures, including South Asia, the Middle East, and Turkey. The name carries spiritual significance, reflecting the importance of intentions and outcomes in one's actions.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Anjam holds significant relevance due to its historical connection to Prophet Ibrahim (AS). It serves as a reminder of the strength and unwavering faith of a prophet who was eager to have children in old age and prayed for Allah's mercy and grant. The name, therefore, reminds us of the courage and determination embedded in the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: Anjam holds spiritual significance due to its association with Prophet Ibrahim (AS) and the trial of his prayer for a child. It signifies the triumph of faith, as Allah, in His infinite mercy, grants Ibrahim (AS) a son at an advanced age. The name invites us to reflect on the power of faith and the divine intervention that can occur when we turn to AllahSWT in times of need. It serves as a reminder of the steadfastness and perseverance required in seeking Allah's blessings and is a beautiful reminder of the promise of Allah to provide sustenance to those who trust in Him.
